results.title: California attorney general: Trump can't interfere with voting
results.description: (The Center Square) – California Attorney General Rob Bonta stands by a lawsuit he’s co-leading to stop President Donald Trump's executive order on mail-in ballots.

results.title: NOUN don advocates stronger media action on maternal, child health rights
results.description: A Professor of Mass Communication at the National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN), Henrietta Chidinma Onwubere, has called for a stronger and more strategic media role in promoting and protecting maternal and child health rights across Nigeria.
